note: Global site header -- renders: skip-to-content, GitHub logo, navigation menu (Product/Solutions/Enterprise/Marketplace/Explore), search trigger, Sign in, Sign up, and appearance settings
Repository header controls -- renders: Watch, Fork, Star buttons and their fixed labels; excludes the repository name and owner which are user-generated
Repository navigation tabs -- renders: Code, Issues, Pull requests, Actions, Projects, Security and quality, Insights
File tree sidebar controls -- renders: 'Files' heading, branch selector, and search box; excludes the file tree which lists user-created file and directory names
Code view sticky header controls -- renders: view mode toggles (Code/Issues/Blame), raw/copy/download buttons, and table of contents toggle; excludes breadcrumb and filename which are user-generated
Blob view header controls -- renders: Code/Issues/Blame tabs, file size, raw/copy/download buttons, and table of contents toggle
